_doc: Expected Playwright case outcomes for the console (browser) lane — the input of
SOURCE OF TRUTH for the case titles: the specs console.sh's SPECS names
the spec; console.sh refuses to start when a spec it was asked to run has no
entry here, and the guard refuses to pass when the report collected a case no
entry declares — so neither a renamed case nor a newly added spec can slip
expect: 'passed'  -> every recorded final result status must be exactly 'passed'.
expect: 'skipped' -> the case may pass, or skip ONLY for a reason listed in
the lane. A declared skip is explicit, not silent.
AC-307-01: this manifest is the whole list of cases the lane is allowed to run.
AC-307-03: nothing here downgrades a case to a warning; every entry is enforced.

cases.title: Rollback from the release inventory creates a ROLLBACK operation and lands on its detail (AC-240-02)
cases.covers: AC-240-02 — REQ-056 AC-056-08 browser rollback path (TASK-240)

cases.title: an illegal target revision is refused by the SERVER, not only by the form guard (AC-240-03)
cases.covers: AC-240-03 — server-side refusal of an illegal rollback target

cases.title: Inventory → Emergency → Execute → Operation Detail (REQUIRE_PROMOTION)
cases.covers: REQ-058 single-actor emergency walkthrough; the CI lane leaves a bound release and a fresh operator observation behind, so its BOUND_RELEASE_PRECONDITION does not apply here

cases.title: Convergence: Prepare → ValuesEditor draft → Submit → cross-actor Approve
cases.covers: AC-058-41 — the cross-actor approval flow (TASK-270's original single guarded case)

cases.title: Kill switch: new entry 404 while existing paths stay reachable (AC-058-05)
cases.why: The gate under test only exists on a stack started with emergencyChangeEnabled=false (web/e2e/emergency-smoke.spec.ts:206-209), and this lane builds the default stack with the feature enabled; the case therefore cannot execute here. Declaring that skip is the opposite of the silent skip this guard exists to stop: if it skips for another reason, fails, or times out, the lane goes red.

cases.title: H1 登录：成功离开登录页并下发会话 cookie；失败留在登录页且显示失败文案
cases.covers: docs/delivery-evidence.md §4.2 H1 — login success (session cookie present, URL leaves the login route inside the 4s budget) and login failure (visible copy, no session, stays on the login route)

cases.title: H2 关键页可达：客户 → 集群 → 发布清单 → 创建操作 → 操作历史 → 操作详情
cases.covers: docs/delivery-evidence.md §4.2 H2 — every hop from the home workbench to the operation detail has a visible entry and the right page title; the operation-history hop uses the definition smoke.sh drove (E2E_DEFINITION_ID), so the lane's own prerequisite supplies the rows

cases.title: H3 危险操作确认：回滚走自定义 alertdialog，Esc 取消且不发出请求
cases.covers: docs/delivery-evidence.md §4.2 H3 — the rollback confirmation is a custom role=alertdialog (no native confirm), Escape closes it, and no RollbackRelease request leaves the browser

cases.title: H4 读取失败：ErrorState 渲染含 requestId 的相关行，且与空态不同屏
cases.covers: docs/delivery-evidence.md §4.2 H4 (read failure) — the aggregated read is rewritten in flight into a 503 carrying X-Request-ID; the ErrorState's technical details must show code=Unavailable · requestId=…, and the empty state must not share the screen (UX-010)

cases.title: H4 权限不足：403 渲染 403 文案而非空态，且与读取失败可区分
cases.covers: docs/delivery-evidence.md §4.2 H4 (403) — a PERMISSION_DENIED response routes to the forbidden surface with the 403 marker and the server's message, distinguishable from the read-failure state, with no empty state

cases.title: H5 焦点陷阱：对话框内 Tab 与 Shift+Tab 不逃逸，Esc 关闭后焦点回到触发按钮
cases.covers: docs/delivery-evidence.md §4.2 H5 — Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside the rollback dialog (AppDialog/useFocusTrap) and closing returns focus to the trigger button

cases.title: S1 解锁页可达：从工作台进入，且渲染空态或有锁态（不同屏、不落错误态）
cases.covers: REQ-087 §4.1/§4.2 unlock-page route + render (TASK-328) — the workbench tile reaches /emergency/stuck-locks and the real aggregate read settles into exactly one terminal state; no mock at all

cases.title: S2 释放确认：有锁态打开 alertdialog，Esc 取消且不发出释放请求
cases.covers: AC-087-08 (TASK-328) — the irreversible-release confirmation is a role=alertdialog with the lock's path in its title and its warning wired via aria-describedby; Escape closes it and no ReleaseEmergencyLock request leaves the browser. The list response is rewritten in flight (a real stuck lock needs the operator to miss the observe window, which this lane does not produce); the release request counter is real

cases.title: S3 释放提交：空原因被服务前守卫拦住，提交后载荷与可见反馈一致
cases.covers: AC-087-08/09 (TASK-328) — an empty reason is refused before any request; the accepted submission carries intentId/reason/mode/evidence as the server requires (decoded from the outgoing frame), and the store's own re-read removes the row and shows the release notice. Both RPC responses are rewritten in flight; the server-side release semantics live in internal/orchestrator/emergency_stuck_handler_test.go
